brief:
Images released by the Ma'an news agency expose Israeli occupation soldiers providing support to settlers during confrontations against Palestinians in the West Bank. The photographs document military personnel positioned alongside settlers in what appears to be coordinated action in the disputed territory.

The images represent the latest visual evidence of collaboration between Israeli forces and settler groups operating in Palestinian areas of the West Bank. Such documented instances have become increasingly common as tensions remain high across communities throughout the region. The release of the photographs underscores the pattern of military involvement in settler activities that Palestinian observers say demonstrates official coordination in actions against the Palestinian population.
title: Photos show Israeli soldiers backing settlers against Palestinians in West Bank
